Nora (CS Ops): quick ask  Enablement can we emit a compact completion webhook so CS tooling can auto-log activities, queue follow-ups, and recommend playbooks? Need owner mapping and opt-out handling.
Ethan (Eng): yes. endpoint /webhooks/enablement/complete on ops-api. signed HMAC + idempotency.
Nora (CS Ops): required fields: account_id, contact_id, completion_id, training_key, event_ts, nps (optional), feedback (optional). include opt_out enum when set.
Priya (Product): include curriculum_tag and curriculum_version if available. product wants to compute per-curriculum recommended_health_delta and optionally send it as recommended_delta.
Liam (CS Manager): gating: always tag enablement.received. apply recommended_delta after 14 days unless negative signal appears. if nps <=7 auto-enqueue playbook renewal_nudge_low_nps. backfill last 90 days and export CSV with owner_email for prioritization.
Ethan (Eng): sample payload and headers in PR. idempotency key = sha256(account_id + completion_id). retry 3x with exp backoff. will add admin backfill `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=90&dry_run=true`.
Nora (CS Ops): audit: write internal audit note with meta.source=enablement and meta.idempotency_key. if opt_out present, keep internal log only.
infra-bot: Created ticket CS-5210 assigned to Ethan.
Ethan (Eng): timeline: PR by Thu EOD, dry-run backfill Fri, feature-flag canary next Tue for org 555000, include HMAC verification snippet and sample webhook file.
Nora (CS Ops): thanks  I'll compile owner list & opt-out exceptions and post here when ready. Please drop PR link in this thread. :thumbsup:
